name: Basic 10 sec
xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1" ?>
<scenario name="Basic Call, 10 seconds Duration, then Send BYE">

  <send retrans="500">
    <![CDATA[
      INVITE sip:[field1]@[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0
      Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch]
      Max-Forwards: 70
      To: <sip:[field1]@[remote_ip]:[remote_port]>
      From: <sip:[field0]@[local_ip]:[local_port]>;tag=[call_number]
      Call-ID: [call_id]
      CSeq: 1 INVITE
      Contact: <sip:[field0]@[local_ip]:[local_port]>
      Content-Type: application/sdp
      Content-Length: [len]

      v=0
      o=user1 53655765 2353687637 IN IP4 [local_ip]
      s=-
      c=IN IP4 [local_ip]
      t=0 0
      m=audio [media_port] RTP/AVP 0
      a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
    ]]>
  </send>

  <recv response="100" optional="true">
  </recv>

  <recv response="180" optional="true">
  </recv>

  <recv response="200" retrans="500">
  </recv>

  <send>
    <![CDATA[
      ACK sip:[field1]@[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0
      Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch]
      Max-Forwards: 70
      To: <sip:[field1]@[remote_ip]:[remote_port]>[peer_tag_param]
      From: <sip:[field0]@[local_ip]:[local_port]>;tag=[call_number]
      Call-ID: [call_id]
      CSeq: 1 ACK
      Contact: <sip:[field0]@[local_ip]:[local_port]>
      Content-Length: 0
    ]]>
  </send>

  <pause milliseconds="60050"/>

  <send retrans="500">
    <![CDATA[
      BYE sip:[field1]@[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0
      Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch]
      Max-Forwards: 70
      To: <sip:[field1]@[remote_ip]:[remote_port]>[peer_tag_param]
      From: <sip:[field0]@[local_ip]:[local_port]>;tag=[call_number]
      Call-ID: [call_id]
      CSeq: 2 BYE
      Contact: <sip:[field0]@[local_ip]:[local_port]>
      Content-Length: 0
    ]]>
  </send>

  <recv response="200">
  </recv>

</scenario>
